name: Unreal Tournament: Game of the Year Edition
description: Unreal Tournament: Game of the Year Edition is a singleplayer and multiplayer first-person arena shooter game and the first in the Unreal Tournament series.

steam.store_details: Delisted in December 2022, when Epic pulled the entire classic Unreal series from sale.
steam.patches:
Creative's official 'EAX Library Patch' (uteaxsys.zip, then uteaxdm.zip and uteaxctf.zip) adds full EAX 2.0 reverb and muffling of sounds through walls to the original Deathmatch and Capture the Flag maps — historically mirrored at patches-scrolls.com.

OldUnreal's patches add a modern 'ALAudio' sound renderer, a strong alternative worth trying. It replaces the game's original EAX sound, so use one or the other.

audio_settings.title: Enable EAX reverb
audio_settings.reason: Unreal Tournament ships with its hardware sound option off, and it only plays EAX reverb with it on.

audio_settings.title: Enable Dolby Pro Logic
audio_settings.reason: Turns on Dolby Pro Logic, A compatible AV receiver or Soundbar is required for Surround sound. Dolby Pro Logic is an analog matrix surround-sound codec technology.
audio_settings.follow_up: Don't forget to set your AV receiver or Soundbar to Dolby Pro Logic.

optional_settings.title: Raise sound quality
optional_settings.reason: Unreal Tournament: Game of the Year Edition mixes its sound at a low sample rate, which dulls high-pitched sounds.

optional_settings.title: Raise texture filtering
optional_settings.reason: Unreal Tournament: Game of the Year Edition filters textures at a low level, so a visible line shows where each floor and wall texture switches to a blurrier version.

optional_settings.title: Raise color depth
optional_settings.reason: Unreal Tournament: Game of the Year Edition runs fullscreen with a reduced color range, so smooth shading like skies and shadows shows visible bands.

optional_settings.title: Enable WASD controls
optional_settings.reason: Unreal Tournament moves with the arrow keys out of the box, and its Ctrl key jumps instead of crouching.
